jobs.title: EGSE/Avionics Test Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Quantum Space is redefining mobility and maneuverability in space. Our high-mobility spacecraft platforms support national security, civil, and commercial missions with unmatched flexibility and propulsion capability. We build fast and iterate quickly.

Who We’re Looking For

We are seeking a technically driven EGSE/ Avionics Test Software Engineer to develop automated test software, Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) software, and hardware/software integration test infrastructure for spacecraft avionics supporting Ranger missions.

In this role, you will develop reusable test applications, instrument interfaces, and automated test sequencing capabilities used to verify spacecraft avionics hardware and software. You will work closely with avionics, flight software, electrical, systems, and test engineers to build reliable test infrastructure, troubleshoot complex hardware/software interactions, and ensure test results are accurate, repeatable, and defensible.

This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of software and hardware, solving difficult integration problems, and building robust test systems that directly contribute to flight readiness and mission success.

Where You’ll Make an Impact

Develop automated test software and EGSE software supporting spacecraft avionics development and verification
Design and develop reusable test applications, instrument interfaces, device drivers, test sequencing capabilities, and data acquisition tools
Develop software to control laboratory instrumentation and communicate with embedded avionics hardware
Build maintainable and extensible test frameworks that separate hardware interfaces, test logic, configuration, and data handling
Develop requirements-based verification tests, including positive and negative testing, boundary conditions, failure scenarios, and fault injection
Support hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and hardware/software integration testing of spacecraft avionics
Develop automated functional and performance tests for flight computers and other avionics hardware
Troubleshoot complex hardware, firmware, software, communication interface, and test equipment issues using systematic root-cause analysis
Verify and validate automated test software and test equipment to ensure accurate and reliable results
Implement test logging and data collection practices that provide traceability and reproducibility across hardware and software configurations
Collaborate with avionics, flight software, systems, electrical, and test teams to develop verification approaches and resolve integration issues
Participate in code reviews and contribute to software development, configuration management, and continuous integration practices
Operate within a fast-paced development environment focused on rapid execution, technical excellence, and mission success

What It Takes

Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline
Experience developing automated test software using LabVIEW, Python, C/C++, or equivalent programming environments
Experience developing software that controls laboratory instrumentation and communicates with embedded hardware
Experience developing reusable and maintainable automated test applications, frameworks, or test infrastructure
Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing complex hardware/software integration issues
Understanding of software verification principles, including requirements-based testing, boundary conditions, negative testing, and fault injection
Experience verifying that automated test software and test equipment are operating correctly and producing reliable results
Familiarity with software configuration management and version control tools such as Git
Strong software debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Nice-to-Have Experience

Experience developing automated test systems or EGSE for spacecraft, aerospace, defense, or other complex embedded systems
Experience developing test frameworks with modular device drivers, reusable interfaces, automated test sequencing, logging, assertions, and configuration management
Experience communicating with hardware over interfaces such as Ethernet, TCP/UDP, RS-422/485, SpaceWire, SPI, I2C, or similar protocols
Experience testing asynchronous hardware and developing software that accounts for timing, synchronization, timeouts, and communication errors
Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and simulation environments
Experience developing automated power-on, functional, or acceptance testing for flight computers or other avionics hardware
Experience with automated fault injection and verification of fault detection, isolation, and recovery behavior
Experience using laboratory instrumentation, protocol analyzers, data acquisition systems, or similar test equipment
Experience developing unit tests, simulated instrument interfaces, or other methods for validating automated test software
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, automated testing, code reviews, and software configuration management
Understanding of embedded firmware and flight software architectures
Experience working with spacecraft avionics or flight hardware
Experience supporting fast-paced aerospace, defense, or commercial space programs

What You’ll Get

Ownership – Take responsibility for automated test software and infrastructure that directly supports the development and verification of mission-critical spacecraft avionics
Innovation – Build robust test frameworks and automation capabilities that accelerate spacecraft development and improve verification efficiency
Impact – Help ensure spacecraft avionics and flight systems perform reliably through rigorous, repeatable, and defensible testing
Growth – Work across avionics, flight software, electrical, systems, and test engineering while expanding your expertise in spacecraft hardware/software integration
Compensation – Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, generous leave, HSA, 401(k) matching, and equity participation

Location:
Rockville, MD or Hawthorne, CA

Base Salary:
$110,000 to $160,000

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Quantum Space's total compensation package.

To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including ITAR, applicants must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual per 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

We wrote it from scratch in Rust and TypeScript; we sync in under 50ms with hundreds of simultaneous editors on a single document, and it costs roughly a dollar per builder per year to run. You find ways to deliver code with agents at high speed without sacrificing the quality of the code or the software.
Experience in building distributed and high-concurrency systems
